nodes.summary: Let $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$ be the Euler products and $a_c(n)$ the generalized cubic partition numbers. For every natural number $c$, $f_1 f_2^{c-1} \sum_{n \ge 0} a_c(n) q^n = 1$ as integer power series in $q$, where for $c = 0$ the exponent $c - 1$ is truncated to $0$.
nodes.title: Generating function identity for generalized cubic partition numbers

nodes.summary: Let $a_c(n)$ be the generalized cubic partition numbers and let $p \ge 7$ be a prime with $p \equiv 3$ or $p \equiv 7 \pmod 8$. Then $a_{p-6}\bigl(pn + 13(p^2 - 1)/24\bigr) \equiv 0 \pmod p$ for every natural number $n$.
nodes.title: Generalized cubic partition congruences modulo primes $p \ge 7$, $p \equiv 3, 7 \pmod 8$

nodes.summary: Let $a_c(n)$ be the generalized cubic partition numbers, let $p$ be a prime with $p \equiv 5$ or $p \equiv 7 \pmod 8$, and let $l$ be a natural number with $p \mid 8l + 3$. Then $a_{p-4}(pn + l) \equiv 0 \pmod p$ for every natural number $n$.
nodes.title: Generalized cubic partition congruences for primes $p \equiv 5, 7 \pmod 8$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the generalized cubic partition numbers satisfy $a_3(7n + 4) \equiv 0 \pmod{7}$ and $a_5(11n + 10) \equiv 0 \pmod{11}$.
nodes.title: Amdeberhan–Sellers–Singh congruences

nodes.summary: For every natural number $c$, the generalized cubic partition number $a_c(0)$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Generalized cubic partitions of zero

nodes.summary: Let $f_k = \prod_{m \ge 1} (1 - q^{km})$ be the Euler products. For natural numbers $c$ and $n$, $a_c(n)$ is the integer coefficient of $q^n$ in the generating function of generalized cubic partitions, the power series $1/(f_1 f_2^{c-1})$. For $c \ge 1$ it is the number of partitions of $n$ whose even parts may each come in $c$ colors; $c = 1$ gives the partition numbers and $c = 2$ Chan's cubic partition numbers.…

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.
